IPL Trade Speculation Surrounds KL Rahul and Rinku Singh

Speculation is mounting regarding potential player movements in the Indian Premier League (IPL) ahead of the 2027 season. Reports suggest KL Rahul might leave the Delhi Capitals franchise, with the team posting a video that some interpret as a hint. Concurrently, there are growing calls for Rinku Singh to captain the Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) following his strong performance in the UpT20 League, with some fans believing he has emerged as the team's captain.
